aspectRatio.intro: Locked aspect ratio. Present only when the node has a locked ratio.

backgroundColor.intro: Background fill color, read from Figma's `fills` ([ADR 009](https://github.com/DirectedEdges/specs/blob/main/adr/009-color-values.md) explains why the name diverges).

backgroundImage.intro: Image fill. Fallback representation used when no image component is configured.

bottom.figmaKeyNote: Reads from `y` when the vertical constraint is `MAX` or `STRETCH`. See [ADR 041 — Layout Positioning](https://github.com/DirectedEdges/specs/blob/main/adr/041-layout-positioning.md).
bottom.intro: Offset from the block-end (bottom) edge. Present when the vertical constraint is `MAX` or `STRETCH`.

centerHorizontalOffset.figmaKeyNote: Reads from `x` when the horizontal constraint is `CENTER`. See [ADR 041 — Layout Positioning](https://github.com/DirectedEdges/specs/blob/main/adr/041-layout-positioning.md).
centerHorizontalOffset.intro: Horizontal offset from center. Present when the horizontal constraint is `CENTER`.

centerVerticalOffset.figmaKeyNote: Reads from `y` when the vertical constraint is `CENTER`. See [ADR 041 — Layout Positioning](https://github.com/DirectedEdges/specs/blob/main/adr/041-layout-positioning.md).
centerVerticalOffset.intro: Vertical offset from center. Present when the vertical constraint is `CENTER`.

clipsContent.intro: Whether the container clips content that overflows its box.

cornerRadius.intro: Corner radius. Scalar when uniform; [`Corners`](/schema/corners/) object when per-corner values differ.

crossAxisAlignment.intro: Alignment along the cross axis (perpendicular to `layoutMode`).

end.figmaKeyNote: Reads from `x` when the horizontal constraint is `MAX` or `STRETCH`. See [ADR 041 — Layout Positioning](https://github.com/DirectedEdges/specs/blob/main/adr/041-layout-positioning.md).
end.intro: Offset from the inline-end edge (right in LTR, left in RTL). Present when the horizontal constraint is `MAX` or `STRETCH`.

fillColor.intro: Glyph/vector fill color, read from Figma's `fills` ([ADR 013](https://github.com/DirectedEdges/specs/blob/main/adr/013-icon-fillColor.md) explains why the name diverges).

itemReverseZIndex.intro: Whether children stack in reverse z-index order.

itemSpacing.intro: Item spacing. Scalar when uniform; [`ItemSpacing`](#itemspacing) object when horizontal and vertical gaps differ.

locked.intro: Whether the element is locked from editing in Figma.

mainAxisAlignment.intro: Alignment along the main axis (depends on `layoutMode`).

maxLines.intro: Maximum number of lines before `textOverflow: "ELLIPSIS"` applies.

padding.intro: Padding. Scalar when uniform; [`Sides`](/schema/sides/) object when per-side values differ.

position.figmaKeyNote: Reads from `layoutPositioning`. See [ADR 041 — Layout Positioning](https://github.com/DirectedEdges/specs/blob/main/adr/041-layout-positioning.md) for why `position` diverges from Figma's naming.
position.intro: Layout positioning mode — whether the element participates in its parent's auto-layout flow or is positioned absolutely.

start.figmaKeyNote: Reads from `x` when the horizontal constraint is `MIN`, `STRETCH`, or `SCALE`. See [ADR 041 — Layout Positioning](https://github.com/DirectedEdges/specs/blob/main/adr/041-layout-positioning.md).
start.intro: Offset from the inline-start edge (left in LTR, right in RTL). Present when the horizontal constraint is `MIN`, `STRETCH`, or `SCALE`.

strokeAlign.intro: Stroke alignment relative to the element's bounds.

strokeDashPattern.intro: Dash geometry for a dashed stroke. Presence signals a dashed stroke; null or absent signals solid.

strokeWeight.intro: Stroke weight. Scalar when uniform; [`Sides`](/schema/sides/) object when per-side values differ.

textAlignHorizontal.figmaKeyNote: Reads from `textAlignHorizontal`, remapped to logical directions (`LEFT`→`START`, `RIGHT`→`END`, `JUSTIFIED`→`JUSTIFY`). See [ADR 064 — Text Align Horizontal](https://github.com/DirectedEdges/specs/blob/main/adr/064-text-align-horizontal.md).
textAlignHorizontal.intro: Horizontal text alignment using logical inline-axis directions. `START` resolves to left in LTR and right in RTL; `END` is the inverse.

textAlignVertical.intro: Vertical text alignment within the node's bounds.

textColor.intro: Text fill color, read from Figma's `fills` ([ADR 009](https://github.com/DirectedEdges/specs/blob/main/adr/009-color-values.md) explains why the name diverges).

textOverflow.intro: How overflowing text is handled — cut off or trailing ellipsis.

top.figmaKeyNote: Reads from `y` when the vertical constraint is `MIN`, `STRETCH`, or `SCALE`. See [ADR 041 — Layout Positioning](https://github.com/DirectedEdges/specs/blob/main/adr/041-layout-positioning.md).
top.intro: Offset from the block-start (top) edge. Present when the vertical constraint is `MIN`, `STRETCH`, or `SCALE`.

typeExamples.example: `if: { condition: {op: isNotNull, args: [...]}, then: true, else: false }`

wrapAlignment.intro: Space distribution between wrapped lines. Only meaningful when `wrap` is `true`.

sections.Properties:
| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `colorSpace` | `string` | Yes | Color space identifier per DTCG Color §4.2 (e.g. `srgb`, `oklch`, `display-p3`) |
| `components` | `(number \| 'none')[]` | Yes | Ordered component values for the given color space |
| `alpha` | `number` | No | Alpha channel 0–1. Defaults to 1 (fully opaque) when omitted |
| `hex` | `string` | No | Optional 6-digit sRGB fallback (`#RRGGBB`) — alpha excluded per DTCG §4.1 |

```yaml
colorSpace: srgb
components: [1, 0.4, 0]
alpha: 1
hex: "#FF6600"
```

The `colorSpace` field is typed as `string` rather than a literal union to avoid drift with the schema enum — the schema provides the validation constraint. 14 `colorSpace` values are supported, corresponding to DTCG Color §4.2.

This shape mirrors `ColorObject` in `schema/styles.schema.json`.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `topStart` | [`Style`](/schema/styles.md/#values) | No | Top-start corner |
| `topEnd` | [`Style`](/schema/styles.md/#values) | No | Top-end corner |
| `bottomEnd` | [`Style`](/schema/styles.md/#values) | No | Bottom-end corner |
| `bottomStart` | [`Style`](/schema/styles.md/#values) | No | Bottom-start corner |

Corner names use logical directions (`topStart`/`bottomEnd`) rather than physical (`topLeft`/`bottomRight`) for bidirectional layout support.
sections.Examples:
When all corners are the same, `cornerRadius` is a scalar:

```yaml
cornerRadius: 8
```

When corners differ, `cornerRadius` is a `Corners` object:

```yaml
cornerRadius:
  topStart: 8
  topEnd: 8
  bottomEnd: 0
  bottomStart: 0
```

sections.Properties:
| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `top` | [`Style`](/schema/styles.md/#values) | No | Top edge |
| `end` | [`Style`](/schema/styles.md/#values) | No | Inline-end (right in LTR) |
| `bottom` | [`Style`](/schema/styles.md/#values) | No | Bottom edge |
| `start` | [`Style`](/schema/styles.md/#values) | No | Inline-start (left in LTR) |

Side names use logical directions (`start`/`end`) rather than physical (`left`/`right`) for bidirectional layout support.
sections.Examples:
When all sides are the same, `padding` is a scalar:

```yaml
padding: 16
```

When sides differ, `padding` is a `Sides` object:

```yaml
padding:
  top: 8
  end: 16
  bottom: 8
  start: 16
```

sections.Properties:
| Name | Category | Description | Default |
|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| [`shadows`](/schema/effects/shadows/) | shadow | Array of drop and inner shadow definitions | absent (no shadows) |
| [`layerBlur`](/schema/effects/layer-blur/) | blur | Layer blur (`filter: blur()`) | absent (no blur) |
| [`backgroundBlur`](/schema/effects/background-blur/) | blur | Background blur (`backdrop-filter: blur()`) | absent (no blur) |
sections.Values:
| Name | Description | Example |
|------|-------------|---------|
| `Shadow` | A single shadow definition | `{ visible: true, offsetX: 0, offsetY: 2, blur: 4, spread: 0, color: "#00000040" }` |
| `Blur` | A blur definition | `{ visible: true, radius: 8 }` |

### Shadow

Defaults below are the evaluator's field defaults before a Figma shadow effect is read — see [`Shadow`](https://github.com/DirectedEdges/specs-from-figma/blob/main/packages/specs-from-figma/src/Component/Effects/Shadow.ts) in specs-from-figma.

| Property | Type | Required | Description | Default |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `visible` | `boolean` | Yes | Whether the shadow is active | `true` |
| `inset` | `boolean` | No | `true` for inner shadow; absent or `false` for drop shadow | absent (drop shadow) |
| `offsetX` | `number \| TokenReference` | Yes | Horizontal offset | `0` |
| `offsetY` | `number \| TokenReference` | Yes | Vertical offset | `0` |
| `blur` | `number \| TokenReference` | Yes | Blur radius | `0` |
| `spread` | `number \| TokenReference` | Yes | Spread distance | `0` |
| `color` | `string \| TokenReference` | Yes | Shadow color (`#RRGGBBAA` or [token](/schema/token-reference/)) | transparent black (`#00000000`) |

### Blur

Defaults below are the evaluator's field defaults before a Figma blur effect is read — see [`Blur`](https://github.com/DirectedEdges/specs-from-figma/blob/main/packages/specs-from-figma/src/Component/Effects/Blur.ts) in specs-from-figma.

| Property | Type | Required | Description | Default |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `visible` | `boolean` | Yes | Whether the blur is active | `true` |
| `radius` | `number \| TokenReference` | Yes | Blur radius | `0` |
sections.Example:
```yaml
shadows:
  - visible: true
    offsetX: 0
    offsetY: 4
    blur: 8
    spread: 0
    color:
      $token: DS Color.Shadow.Default
      $type: color
  - visible: true
    inset: true
    offsetX: 0
    offsetY: 1
    blur: 0
    spread: 1
    color: "#0000001A"
backgroundBlur:
  visible: true
  radius: 12
```

gradient-value.intro:
A gradient fill value. Accepted by color properties (`backgroundColor`, `fillColor`, `strokes`, `textColor`) as an alternative to a solid color string or token reference.

```ts
type GradientValue = LinearGradient | RadialGradient | AngularGradient;
```

DIAMOND gradients are intentionally excluded — they have no native CSS, SwiftUI, or Compose equivalent.

sections.Properties:
All three gradient types share the same base properties, with `LinearGradient` using `angle` and the others using `center`.

### LinearGradient

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `type` | `'LINEAR'` | Yes | |
| `angle` | `number` | Yes | Gradient angle in degrees |
| `stops` | `GradientStop[]` | Yes | Color stops |

```yaml
type: LINEAR
angle: 180
stops:
  - position: 0
    color: "#FFFFFFFF"
  - position: 1
    color:
      $token: DS Color.Surface.Muted
      $type: color
```

### RadialGradient

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `type` | `'RADIAL'` | Yes | |
| `center` | `GradientCenter` | Yes | Center point |
| `stops` | `GradientStop[]` | Yes | Color stops |

```yaml
type: RADIAL
center:
  x: 0.5
  y: 0.5
stops:
  - position: 0
    color: "#FFFFFFFF"
  - position: 1
    color: "#00000000"
```

### AngularGradient

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `type` | `'ANGULAR'` | Yes | |
| `center` | `GradientCenter` | Yes | Center point |
| `stops` | `GradientStop[]` | Yes | Color stops |

```yaml
type: ANGULAR
center:
  x: 0.5
  y: 0.5
stops:
  - position: 0
    color: "#FF0000FF"
  - position: 0.33
    color: "#00FF00FF"
  - position: 0.66
    color: "#0000FFFF"
  - position: 1
    color: "#FF0000FF"
```
sections.Values:
| Name | Description | Example |
|------|-------------|---------|
| `GradientStop` | A color at a position along the gradient | `{ position: 0.5, color: "#FF0000FF" }` |
| `GradientCenter` | Relative center point (0–1 range) | `{ x: 0.5, y: 0.5 }` |

### GradientStop

| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `position` | `number` | Position along the gradient vector (0–1) |
| `color` | `string \| TokenReference` | Hex color (`#RRGGBBAA`) or [token reference](/schema/token-reference/) |

### GradientCenter

| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `x` | `number` | Horizontal position relative to the fill bounding box (0–1) |
| `y` | `number` | Vertical position relative to the fill bounding box (0–1) |

| Name | Description | Example |
|------|-------------|---------|
| `number` | Literal numeric value | `16` |
| `string` | Literal string value | `"Inter"` |
| `boolean` | Literal boolean value | `true` |
| `'mixed'` | Multiple conflicting values within a single text node | `"mixed"` |
| [`TokenReference`](/schema/token-reference/) | Reference to a design token | `{ $token: "DS.Font.Size.400", $type: "dimension" }` |
| `'NONE' \| 'CAP_HEIGHT'` | Leading trim enum (for `leadingTrim` only) | `"CAP_HEIGHT"` |
sections.Example:
```yaml
fontSize: 14
fontFamily: Inter
fontStyle: Medium
lineHeight: "150%"
letterSpacing: 0
```
